definition.simple: Testing in steps: tune rules on one block of history, test them unchanged on the next block, then slide forward and repeat.
definition.balanced: Only the joined test blocks are judged, since each was tested with rules tuned on earlier data. It shows how rules cope as conditions change. It is still a test of the past with a limited sample, and any leak of future data spoils it.

example: Tune on candles 1–200, test 201–300; tune on 101–300, test 301–400; and so on.
